jump:polymarket:2676730.probability_reasoning: Orikhiv is a heavily fortified town in Zaporizhzhia oblast that has held since 2022, though Russian forces made gains toward it in late 2025 and 2026 from the Huliaipole and Stepnohirsk directions. jump:polymarket:2676730.move_reasoning: Incremental tactical gains on the Ukrainian front, like the falls of Avdiivka or Pokrovsk, have barely moved global markets. A Russian entry into Orikhiv would mean only a marginal geopolitical risk premium: slightly higher gold and oil and a touch of risk-off, all well under a tenth of a typical move.

At most it nudges BOJ hike expectations and the yen slightly, with no meaningful spillover to US stocks, credit, or commodities.
